d: KalSoft is seeking a responsible and organized Field Supervisor to oversee daily field operations, manage team performance, coordinate shift schedules, maintain attendance records, and liaise directly with Municipal IT management.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
Experience in team supervision, field operations, or administrative coordination.
Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills.
Ability to manage schedules, attendance, reporting, and team performance.
r: Supervise daily field operations and monitor team performance to ensure assigned tasks are completed efficiently.
Prepare and coordinate staff shift schedules, duty assignments, and resource allocation.
Maintain accurate attendance records, monitor punctuality, and report staff availability.
Track operational progress, identify performance gaps, and ensure timely resolution of field-related issues.
Coordinate with team members to ensure smooth workflow and effective communication.
Prepare daily and periodic operational reports for management.
Serve as the primary point of contact with Municipal IT management for updates, coordination, and operational requirements.
Ensure compliance with assigned procedures, schedules, and operational guidelines.

d: Maintain fleet seafarers’ records and administer and process seafarers’ payroll accurately and on timely manner, according to the company applicable policies and procedures.
In addition, the role is responsible to maintain marine personnel vendors’ information/records, review and process their related invoices on time.
q: Diploma degree in Accounting or Finance.
Related certificates such as CMA/CPA/ACCA, etc. is an advantage.
3-5 years of related experience in a similar position, preferably in a similar industry. Strong payroll and analytical skills with relevant financial experience.
Reasonable amount of understanding of the Maritime industry and the extensive legal requirements pertaining to employment of marine personnel
Understanding of travel and government procedures
Knowledge of HR principles and practices
Computer literate- Microsoft suite of products
r: Process the monthly seafarers’ wages on-board and ensure the latest Bank account information are updated in the system.
Ensure all the eligible allowances are captured while running the payroll process followed by employment contract and Company P&P.
Ensure all the advances granted to seafarers are deducted.
Obtain relevant approvals and coordinate with finance and treasury functions for timely transfers.
Send pay slips to the seafarers via email or crewing software.
Maintain proper track on any salary return in coordination with treasury and ensure retransfer process has been managed through Ad-hoc payments.
Ensure proper management of Cash to Master, keep appropriate track of deductions against payment and maintain monthly reconciliation.
Prepare and post payroll entries into the system including vessel’s budget and accruals.
Coordinate with GL team and AR to ensure all the back charging payroll costs are managed monthly and on timely manner
Monitor and answer email messages, calls for all related queries.
Independently manage internal and external audits related to Payroll for seafarers
Generate/prepare required reports to Management as required.
Manage seafarers' final and leave settlements as per applicable policies and procedures.
Assisting MPD for preparation and finalizing annual bonus and reward for Seafarers.
Maintain all personnel data related to fleet seafarers and Marine Personnel vendors’ bank accounts in line with the related requirements.
Administer Marine Personnel relevant vendors’ agreements and ensure their validity and timely renewal.
Process and settle relevant vendor invoices in a timely manner
Ensure all documents related to marine personnel are always stored properly and safely.
Timely and accurate disbursement of payroll transactions, and in compliance with all accounting standards
